summary: One practical experiment may give shape to something you have only been able to imagine.
body: One practical experiment may give shape to something you have only been able to imagine. When Neptune sextiles the North Node, a creative idea, compassionate goal, or intuitive hunch can become specific enough to evaluate once you give it a form outside your head. Make the prototype, schedule the meeting, volunteer once, submit the piece, or price the project. You do not need certainty before beginning. You need one action that shows you what the idea can support and what deserves more of your time.
